'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Jan Westergard LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' SAN
* '''Deck name:''' Earl Grey Twist of Lemon
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
